changelog: [feature] Phone Diagnostic: live Watch of any app after a one-time desktop ADB grant, with V/D/I/W/E/F filters, overlay Record / Pause / Stop, and .mdx share to MessageMe or App Builder

[improvement] Phone Watch uses a mesh toolbar, compact full-name filter chips, a dusk log well with chip-colored lines, and Record / Stop / Diagnose
[improvement] Phone Watch log stays still as soon as you scroll up; tap the paused chip to jump back to live
[improvement] Phone Settings is a glass hub with live grant status instead of two empty tiles
[improvement] Intel Mac builds target macOS Big Sur 11.0, so a 11.7.11 Mac can run Diagnostic
[improvement] The Mac disk image includes How to open steps for Control-click Open when Apple cannot check the app
[improvement] The flying Watch window is a glass card with the app icon and name, icon-only Rec / Pause / Stop / Full, a mint activity sweep, and tap-and-drag to move

[improvement] Watch log well matches the pastel chip card so line colors read like the chips
[improvement] Watch filter chips are a little larger, grayscale when off and colored when on
[improvement] The flying window drags from the app name, with larger glyphs, tighter padding, and a mint activity stroke on the top edge
[improvement] Watch log lines are a little larger, heavier, and darker so they read on the pastel well
[improvement] Settings About hero has no white outline around the bird and product name
[improvement] The flying window is a compact dark glass chip with a faint mint activity sweep, a smaller app icon, Record that becomes Stop, Open Diagnostic, and Close

[improvement] Flying-window Open and Close match the Record circle, and the activity sweep is a bright white-mint line on the top edge

[improvement] Phone Watch log rows match Desktop: timestamp, level badge, colored tag, and odd/even backgrounds
[improvement] Diagnose stat cards in a row share height, so Lines scanned matches Top finding
[improvement] Watch puts the package under the app name, wraps filter chips on the left, and pairs icon-only Record and Diagnose on the right
[improvement] Watch overlay control is a glass circle with a stacked flying-window mark, mint when the chip is showing
[improvement] Phone home drops the extra Diagnostic title; version and Settings sit on the hero name row, and search says Search for an app
[improvement] Home Watch tile reads Watch the whole device
[improvement] Phone Watch log rows show time, level, and tag on one line, with the message wrapping underneath
[bugfix] Phone home is titled Diagnostic, with a larger settings control inset from the edge
[bugfix] Watch pauses the live tail on the first upward scroll, not only after a downward nudge
[bugfix] Watch no longer asks for one-time device-log access every time you open an app
[bugfix] Watch Live keeps the log moving as new lines arrive
[bugfix] Watch keeps logcat running when you leave Diagnostic, so HyperOS does not ask for device logs again
[bugfix] Watch pauses Live as soon as you drag away from the newest lines
[bugfix] Phone Diagnose dumps live logcat on every run, including Refresh, instead of replaying the frozen Watch snapshot
